temporal_scope: Preserve original four March/June/September/December2022snapshots for Mauritanian/Baffin and two January/July2022snapshots for northern undercurrents. No padding,temporal averaging or annual extrema.
method: Finite paired component contours and unique linear transverse strips,with native first-to-last minimum support for censored boundaries. Original core windows select original cores without imposing layer limits or detachment.
layer_metric_interpretation: Lower component depth is absolute positive model depth;paired component thickness is lower minus upper,not lower depth. A subsurface search stratum does not force a detached physical layer or cap its depth.
minimum_span_interpretation: Conditional native minimum support under original contiguous piecewise-linear signed-component definition,not a physical named-current thickness bound. Single-level zero is uninformative,not absence.
range_interpretation: Native-bracket conditional geometry scenarios,not physical uncertainty,confidence intervals or annual envelopes.
axis_anchor_interpretation: Original model-selected axes only;19unresolved cases retain null anchors and original candidate diagnoses. No replacement core,date,gate,branch,source stratum or between-section interpolation.
interpretation: Partial regional component geometry,not independently identified current body,water mass,flow-normal width,whole-route depth or physical water volume. No independent terrain clearance.
source_credit: HYCOM Consortium,NRL,COAPS-FSU; original source fields and qualifiers retained.
run_note: Inclusive component-thickness lower support under original contiguous piecewise-linear model definition; single-level zero is an uninformative bound, not absence.
